description: This source file implements the socket-based communication and user prompt handling for executing commands with approval workflows within a macOS environment. It defines data structures for requests and responses, socket server management for handling client connections, and user interface prompts for command approval.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the socket server that prompts for command approvals and delegates execution handling.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptPresenter
classes.description: Provides macOS user interface prompts for command approval using NSAlert and accessory views.

classes.name: ExecHostExecutor
classes.description: Handles validation, approval flow, permission checks, and command execution for remote requests.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: Encapsulates the socket server lifecycle, connection handling, and request processing for socket communication.

methods.name: readLineFromHandle
methods.description: Reads a line from a file handle up to a maximum byte count, handling partial reads and newlines.

methods.name: timingSafeHexStringEquals
methods.description: Performs a timing-safe comparison of two hex strings for security.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronously requests an approval decision from a Unix domain socket;

methods.name: requestDecisionSync
methods.description: Synchronously communicates with the socket to send requests and receive decisions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server, accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and cleans up socket files.

methods.name: openSocket
methods.description: Creates, binds, and listens on a Unix domain socket for incoming connections.

methods.name: handleClient
methods.description: Processes communications from a connected client socket, handling approval requests and command execution requests.

methods.name: sendApprovalResponse
methods.description: Sends an approval decision response back to the client.

methods.name: sendExecResponse
methods.description: Sends execution results back to the client.

methods.name: isAllowedPeer
methods.description: Checks if the connected socket peer is authorized for communication based on UID.

methods.name: handleExecRequest
methods.description: Processes command execution requests, performing validation, approval, permissions, and executing commands.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Evaluates the command execution context asynchronously.

methods.name: persistAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Records persistent allowlist entries based on decisions and context.

methods.name: ensureScreenRecordingAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests permission for screen recording if needed.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes shell commands asynchronously and returns execution results.

methods.name: errorResponse
methods.description: Constructs an error response for command execution or approval issues.

methods.name: successResponse
methods.description: Constructs a successful execution response payload.
